# VibeRaven Public Local Source

Local commands from this checkout:

- Build: npm --prefix packages/cli run build
- UI: node packages/cli/dist/cli.js ui .
- Scan: node packages/cli/dist/cli.js scan .
- Agent mode: node packages/cli/dist/cli.js --agent-mode .
- Verify: node packages/cli/dist/cli.js --verify .

This Phase 1 export is local-only. It writes deterministic .viberaven/ artifacts from repository evidence and excludes private hosted-service, account, paid-tier, runner, remote scan, OpenAI, Polar, and live-provider code.

A normal git push does not require a VibeRaven scan.
